parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The AI template ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
- When you call the [AddAITemplate](~~102930~~) operation to add an AI template, the AI template ID is the value of the TemplateId parameter in the response.
- After the AI template is added, you can call the [ListAITemplate](~~102936~~) operation to query the AI template ID, which is the value of the TemplateId parameter in the response.
